title: Ing Bulong ning Gintu king Ilang
intro: Isipan me ing malawak a kampung keng disyerto keng panaun ning pamag-abang ampo alang kasiguraduan. Ing metung a dakilang lider meko ya para keng pamitipun keng Divine, likuan ne ing metung a komunidad a magnasa para keng metung a bage a akit na. keng alang patugut a pamag-pause, metung a makakumbinsi a tau ing linakad a maki makinang a pangaku ampo metung a matalinong lelangan a balamu mabie.
clues: Metung ku kareng meko keng Ehipto kayabe nang Musa, menakit kung mepitna ing dagat para keng kekaming pamagtakas.
menalbe ku inyang ing kekaming lider minta ya keng bunduk kilub ning apat apulung bengi para tanggap patnube.
Tinipun kung palamuti karing tau at pepahurma ku la king sarili kung gamat.
Ginawa kung metung a biserung baka a babie siwala, at inaus ku la ding tau karin.
Kinangwa kung metung a gamat a alikabuk ibat keng bakas ning tubud at binugsak ke keng gewa ku.
linapit ya i musa at mekondena kung sabyan 'e mu ku tatagkilan' ampo manuknangan kung makabukud, ampo metung a pamitipun a pengaku para keng pamanukum.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
